title: Canonical Requirement count stale
required_fix: Canonical document count inconsistency is centrally corrected to 169 in this currentization. Developer must implement/keep an executable gate that independently parses canonical IDs and 8 legacy aliases; aliases never inflate the denominator.
acceptance: Current canonical header/§21/§22 are 169; developer gate independently proves 169 canonical + 8 legacy aliases and mutation to a wrong count fails.

title: Previous-SHA evidence can be promoted incorrectly
required_fix: Remove hard-coded prior-SHA assumptions from verification. Every gate/evidence record must resolve the actual current HEAD/candidate provenance; old SHA remains provenance only.
acceptance: No PASS can be produced from cd5bacc evidence for successor source. Commands are parameterized/current-HEAD-bound and provenance is immutable.

title: Approval terminal writes are not fenced
required_fix: Carry FENCE_TOKEN/lease owner/command identity from reservation through invocation and require matching fence in every terminal execution/request/UNKNOWN/integrity update.
acceptance: Stale owner cannot finalize after re-reservation; race/process-kill tests prove old fence writes affect 0 rows and cannot overwrite new owner result.

title: Center-Cut non-terminal states can resolve UNKNOWN as success
required_fix: Only explicit terminal states may resolve UNKNOWN. RUNNING/RETRYING/PENDING remain UNKNOWN regardless of failedCount/unknownCount.
acceptance: Negative tests for RUNNING/RETRYING/PENDING and no-duplicate-side-effect proof pass.

title: Batch UNKNOWN reconcile uses substring identity
required_fix: Replace concatenated row-values contains() matching with exact structured immutable identity equality: command/operation ID + idempotency key/request hash + approval/target tuple.
acceptance: Collision tests with prefix/suffix/substring-overlapping IDs cannot select unrelated rows.

title: TransactionId trust boundary must preserve official channel-originated lineage
required_fix: Official transaction-originating Channel/System may generate the first valid CPF transactionId. All Local/Remote/REST/SOAP/Gateway/Message/Async/Retry/Batch/File/UNKNOWN/Reconcile hops preserve that same transactionId. Only untrusted spoof/replay/manipulation is blocked using authenticated Channel/System identity and trust policy; do not blanket-regenerate every inbound transactionId.
acceptance: Official channel-generated ID is accepted and preserved end-to-end; retry keeps ID and increments attempt; trusted internal propagation works; untrusted replay/spoof cannot join another lineage; ADM reconstructs the full chain by one transactionId.

title: cpf-core depends on MyBatis-owned mapper implementation
required_fix: Keep topology-independent API/SPI/contracts in cpf-core; move JDBC/MyBatis implementation and mapper ownership downstream to persistence-mybatis or an owning provider module.
acceptance: cpf-core compiles/publishes without persistence-mybatis implementation classes; ArchUnit/dependency gate prevents reverse dependency.

title: DB summary logging is not fail-closed for masking
required_fix: Apply canonical masking/redaction immediately at DB persistence boundary for all summary/detail/member/customer/error fields, independent of producer behavior.
acceptance: Malicious/unmasked record persistence tests prove raw secret/PII cannot reach DB rows or evidence.

title: V107 lineage missing from canonical platform-schema
required_fix: Add transaction lineage model to canonical schema and regenerate/synchronize Oracle/PostgreSQL/MariaDB install/migration/rollback/query/index/retention/generator artifacts.
acceptance: Canonical→DB3 parity is one-way and zero-drift; transactionId/hierarchy indexes and rollback are present in all 3 vendors.

title: DB3 verifier can pass without canonical V107
required_fix: Strengthen verifier to inspect canonical schema, generated vendor artifacts, writer/consumer path and duplicate/path/schema consistency; mutation must fail when canonical lineage is removed.
acceptance: Canonical omission, vendor drift, missing writer and missing rollback mutations are all killed.

title: Lineage source-of-truth/writer ambiguity
required_fix: Central decision: cpf_transaction_lineage is the canonical normalized operational lineage projection/index, not a second domain-event primary. Implement idempotent writers/upserts from segment/attempt/remote/message/batch lifecycle while original domain stores remain detailed sources.
acceptance: Real writer path exists; projection is populated idempotently, reconcileable, retained/purged, and ADM one-shot can use it without dual-primary ambiguity.

title: Retired 410 APIs still advertised as active 200 operations
required_fix: Keep compatibility backend 410 only if necessary, but exclude retired endpoints from active OpenAPI/generated client/consumer counts (e.g. hidden retirement contract).
acceptance: Runtime OpenAPI and checked-in spec contain no active success operation for retired endpoints; generated client has no active methods; 410 compatibility remains testable.

title: Standard error/security responses missing
required_fix: Export canonical error DTO/responses for applicable 401/403/404/409/422/429/500/503 and regenerate typed client/frontend handling.
acceptance: Runtime export = checked-in spec; error matrix tests cover applicable routes.

title: Spool replay bypasses hardened writer safety
required_fix: Replay through the same hardened append primitive or atomically revalidate allowed root, symlink/NOFOLLOW, lock, permissions, path canonicalization and concurrency before recovered append.
acceptance: Symlink swap/path escape/concurrent writer/permission mutation tests cannot redirect or interleave recovered logs.

title: Dedup disabled above 8 MiB
required_fix: Replace whole-file-size-based marker scan with durable idempotency/dedup ledger or bounded indexed strategy independent of target file size.
acceptance: Duplicate replay is prevented for >8MiB logs, rotation, restart and concurrent replay.

title: Spool root/retry lifecycle is not truly durable
required_fix: Default to explicit managed durable spool root (not java.io.tmpdir), startup scan plus bounded autonomous scheduled retry/lease/backoff, shutdown drain, corruption quarantine and terminal-loss alert.
acceptance: Hard-kill→restart→no-new-write replay succeeds; ephemeral tmp loss is impossible by default; disk-full/read-only/corruption/restart evidence is generated.

title: FileLog recovery tests/gates are false-green
required_fix: Add executable fault tests and mutations for duplicate replay, >8MiB, symlink swap, hard kill, restart persistence, autonomous retry, disk full, corruption, quarantine and terminal alert.
acceptance: Removing durable root/retry/dedup/safety causes tests/gates to fail.

title: Observability qualifier accepts synthetic authoritative-looking records
required_fix: Require independent authenticated store provenance, mandatory sourceSha, immutable record IDs, workload-side evidence and cross-source correlation that one fake server cannot self-attest.
acceptance: QA fake qualification server pattern fails; records must be tied to independently produced workload and exact SHA.

title: Security negative gate has labels without attack semantics
required_fix: Define category-specific corpus schemas/payloads/assertions for XSS/CSRF/SSRF/IDOR/replay/tamper/authorization/tenant boundaries and verify actual negative behavior.
acceptance: Always-403 trivial server plus label-only corpus cannot pass; semantic mutations are killed.

title: Resource gate ignores observed vs declared limits
required_fix: Compare measured numeric observations to declared limits/budgets and require workload, cleanup, saturation/backpressure evidence.
acceptance: limit=1 with observed=999999999 fails deterministically.

title: Batch semantic gate can pass on booleans
required_fix: Require execution IDs, lifecycle state transitions, restart identity, DB/runtime queries, multi-instance ownership and fault evidence.
acceptance: Boolean-only synthetic evidence cannot pass; process-kill/restart identity is verified.

title: Broker semantic gate can pass on booleans
required_fix: Require message IDs/offsets, producer/consumer evidence, reconnect fault, retry/DLQ and measured queue/backpressure evidence.
acceptance: Boolean-only evidence cannot pass; real broker sequence and fault recovery are proven.

title: DR gate accepts self-attested RPO/RTO
required_fix: Drive faults from an independent harness; compute data/artifact hashes and observed recovery times outside target response.
acceptance: Self-attested booleans/RPO/RTO cannot pass; restore integrity and observed RPO/RTO are externally measured.

title: DB3 lifecycle default runner does not exist
required_fix: Provide a real canonical runner module/classpath or change script to a real supported runner. Validate default invocation from clean checkout.
acceptance: run-db3-lifecycle default path resolves to real compiled class and supports install→upgrade→rollback→reapply for all vendors.

title: ADM CSP allows unpkg and unsafe-eval
required_fix: Remove external runtime CDN and unsafe-eval unless an exact unavoidable exception is centrally justified; prefer self-hosted assets + nonce/hash CSP.
acceptance: Runtime response-header tests prove no external runtime dependency and no unsafe-eval.

title: Mandatory Runtime Qualification remains incomplete
required_fix: Fix source/gate blockers first, then make all 13 qualification axes executable and current-HEAD bound. Execute every axis available in the environment and package exact commands/results; never mark unavailable axes PASS.
acceptance: No hard-coded old SHA; all 13 axes have runnable scripts, explicit prerequisites, PASS/FAIL criteria, immutable evidence schema and no false-green shortcuts.

title: 13 PRODUCT_ADM/MERGE_EDU concrete handlers remain
required_fix: Do not delete without user approval. Remove runtime-handler behavior without deletion: PRODUCT_ADM/MERGE_EDU artifacts must become non-executable reference/redirect metadata only, must not implement/register handler contracts or duplicate Product logic. Prepare exact DELETE_MANIFEST candidates separately if physical cleanup is still desired.
acceptance: Only 4 EXTENSION_SAMPLE handlers are executable/registered; 13 Product/Merge artifacts have no Product duplicate logic, bean/handler registration or consumer visibility.

title: Retained EDU-ADM extension role differs from canonical ADM role
required_fix: Central decision: retained EXTENSION_SAMPLE EDU-ADM 02/03/04/07 use canonical `CPF_ADM_OPERATOR` contract unless the canonical role model itself is formally changed. Do not weaken QA37.
acceptance: Handler definition role, canonical catalog, tests and QA37 --compile all agree; mutation to reference-platform role fails.

title: One-shot freshness treats N/A sources as missing
required_fix: Model APPLICABLE / NOT_APPLICABLE / AVAILABLE / FAILED / STALE separately based on transaction topology/capabilities/observed events.
acceptance: Pure local, remote, message, batch, DLQ and mixed-partial tests report correct applicability without false degradation.

title: HIGH/CRITICAL mutations bypass generated client
required_fix: Central decision: keep the strict gate. Migrate all HIGH/CRITICAL mutation callsites to generated typed cpf-api operations. A wrapper is allowed only if it is a typed adapter over a generated operation and the gate can trace the operationId; no raw admMutation/admInvoke bypass.
acceptance: Full ADM consumer gate reports zero high-risk generated-client violations and no unapproved waivers.

title: Approval Simulation lacks explicit action permission/generated client
required_fix: Add canonical SIMULATE action permission/rule, backend direct-call enforcement and generated typed client consumer.
acceptance: Role-matrix negative tests and consumer-gate mutation prove permission and client contract cannot drift.
